note: Regenerate with `--update` and commit. Both directions are checked; a shrink means something stopped being included. Rose 3.26 MB at v0.5.1 when every texture was reimported with mipmaps - a full mip chain is a third again on top of the base level, and it is the single biggest look fix in the game. Rose 8.09 MB at R4 for the SHED: nine imported props and a plank material for a room the player is rowed to. That was 29 MB before it was cut - CI caught it at +81% and the local run had passed only because it measured a stale APK in build/, so run check.ps1 -Export when assets change. The cut was `process/size_limit`: 512 on everything in the shed and 256 on the five props that are only ever background, which took 64.58 MB to 43.71 with no visible difference in a screenshot from where the player stands. There is no download-size constraint on this stack, but a room is not worth 29 MB.
